scope: Corollary 9.3 (Smooth initial form) of the manuscript “A cubic lower bound for border determinantal complexity of the permanent” (preprints/A-cubic-lower-bound-for-border-determinantal-complexity-of-the-permanent-September-24-2026/A-cubic-lower-bound-for-border-determinantal-complexity-of-the-permanent-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 108 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9eb71358fe8d9e08), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 33. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let g ∈ C[x1, . . . , xd], where d ≥ 2, and let a ∈ Cd. Suppose that the lowest nonzero homogeneous term Gr(x) of g(a + x) has degree r ≥ 2 and defines a smooth hypersurface in Pd−1. Then dc(g) ≥ (r − 1)(d − 1) 4e . The same lower bound holds for dc(g).
